777:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Bridge ～

777:t_1:5.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Most of the sensors aren't functioning!」

777:t_1:6.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「GPS and our other systems have lost position data too! It appears all $c ships have been thrown into subspace!」

777:t_1:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Are the $$ラー・カイラム$$ and the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ here too!?」

777:t_1:8.en:
$$ボビー$$
「The $$ラー・カイラム$$, the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ and the $$プトレマイオス$$ are near the $$クォーター$$! The $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ is a bit farther off!」

777:t_1:9.en:
$$キャシー$$
「I've just grasped the status of every unit!」

777:t_1:10.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The $$ロンド・ベル$$ mobile suits have been taken aboard the $$ラー・カイラム$$, and the $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ units aboard the $$プトレマイオス$$! The $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ and $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ have returned to this ship!」

777:t_1:11.en:
$$キャシー$$
「$$アクエリオンＥＶＯＬ#robot$$, Ensign $$レド$$ and Ensign $$セツコ$$ are aboard this ship too!」

777:t_1:12.en:
$$ラム$$
「$$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, $$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$, $$ザンボット３$$, the $$マジンガーチーム$$, $$ゲッター$$, the $$クラッシャー隊$$, $$大グレン団$$, $$チームＤ$$, $$トップレス$$, $$ノリコ$$...」

777:t_1:13.en:
$$ラム$$
「$$２１世紀警備保障$$ and $$ランド$$ appear to have been taken in by the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$!」

777:t_1:15.en:
$$キャシー$$
「It seems $$ウルズ$$ Team, the $$黒の騎士団$$, $$キリコ$$, $$ビッグオー$$ and the $$プリベンター$$ are not in this space!」

777:t_1:16.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Wait, what about $n and Miss $$スズネ$$!?」

777:t_1:18.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Check the area around the $$マクロス・クォーター$$」
「Check the area around the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$」

777:t_1:19.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Confirmed! The $$ジェニオン$$ is near this ship!」

777:t_1:21.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「It's no use! This ship will defold shortly!」

777:t_1:22.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Defold coordinates confirmed...! What is this...!?」

$$キャシー$$
「Confirmed! The $$ジェニオン$$ is near the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$!」

777:t_1:26.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Tell them to hurry the recovery!」

777:t_1:50.en: ～ Inside the Imperial Capital $$ラース・バビロン$$ ～

777:t_1:51.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「...$$ストラウス$$. Where has $c ended up?」

777:t_1:53.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The galactic core, huh... They got thrown quite a long way again.」

777:t_1:54.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「That man $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ is rather capable, isn't he?」

777:t_1:55.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「It wasn't the power of that $$時空震動$$ alone.」

777:t_1:56.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「So it's the meddling of those so-called Reformists...」

777:t_1:59.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Never mind. For that, we can just ask the other half of that bunch.」

777:t_1:60.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The $$クロノ$$ agent is coming today, right?」

777:t_1:61.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「By now, $$アウストラリス$$ is probably meeting with that agent.」

777:t_1:62.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「His Majesty the Emperor is a busy man, I see.」

777:t_1:64.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I know, $$ストラウス$$. The ones we should be chasing are them.」

777:t_1:65.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The cursed wanderer, $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$... And then...」

777:t_1:69.en: ～ $$ラース・バビロン$$ Imperial Palace ～

777:t_1:71.en:
$$執務官$$
「Proxy, you may raise your head.」

777:t_1:72.en:
$$グエン$$
「It is an honor to meet you, Your Majesty $$アウストラリス$$.」

777:t_1:73.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「You are permitted to state your name.」

777:t_1:74.en:
$$グエン$$
「I am $$グエン・サード・ラインフォード$$. For reasons of my own, I have now been permitted to join the ranks of $$クロノ$$, the Proxies.」

777:t_1:75.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「What reasons are these?」

777:t_1:76.en:
$$グエン$$
「I have gained the opportunity to know the end of the world... or, put another way, the truth of the world.」

777:t_1:77.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「I see... So you too have touched the truth of these parallel worlds.」

777:t_1:78.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Very well, Lord $$グエン$$. I acknowledge you as my comrade and grant you the qualification to serve as this planet's Proxy.」

777:t_1:79.en:
$$グエン$$
「I am deeply honored, Your Majesty.」

777:t_1:80.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「And now, give praise. Praise the name of Truth...」

777:t_1:81.en:
$$グエン$$
(I thank you, $$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$... for having slipped in the writing notes for the true final chapter of 《$$メトロポリス$$》...)

777:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well. Caught up in the $$時空震動$$, $c has been split into three units.」

777:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, as always, I'll be tagging along with $n.」

777:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, no matter what awaits us down the road, it's another day of giving it my all... business, business!」

777:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... I'm sorry, but this time I'll be taking a break from celebrating our ace pilots.」

777:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have to go and search for $n now, you see.」

ゲッター.evidence: Bare ゲッター in Ram's roll call (777:t_1:12) = the Getter team/unit; no bare token in the sheet (only ゲッター線, ゲッターロボＧ, 真ゲッター series).

kept_omissions: 777:t_1:53: Barbiel's 跳ばされた (subject dropped) written 'They got thrown...' = $c's fleet (Shikuu's question just before asks about $c); could conceivably be the Empire side.
777:t_1:64: 奴等 rendered 'them' (Asakim and whoever Barbiel completes in the next row); not spelled out in the source.
777:t_1:59: 連中の片割れ = 'the other half of that bunch' (the Chrono faction opposite the Reformists); kept as vague as the Japanese.
uncertain: 777:t_1:71/74/78: 代行者 rendered 'Proxy' / 'the Proxies' (only occurrence in the corpus; no glossary entry). Alternatives: Agent, Deputy.
777:t_1:80: 称えるがいい。真理の名を… rendered 'give praise. Praise the name of Truth...'; 'Truth' capitalized as a proper concept, unsure.
777:t_1:77: この並行世界の真理 rendered 'these parallel worlds' (singular この in source).
777:t_1:16: Bobby's $nちゃん written plain '$n' (honorific dropped); could be '$n-chan' as an affectionate nickname. Bobby is male but uses feminine 'わ' speech; English kept neutral.
777:t_1:12: bare ゲッター -> `$$ゲッター$$` (new name, proposed 'Getter'); オックス used as `$$オックス$$` (Ox) following stage 16 and dlg_2200_00.
777:t_1:18: two-option record written as imperative-style 'Check the area around the X' (cf. 764:t_1:89 declarative); the two branches feed rows :19 and :25.
777:t_1:50: 帝都ラース・バビロン内 rendered 'Inside the Imperial Capital $$ラース・バビロン$$'.
777:t_1:6: おそらく folded into 'It appears'.
777:t_1:20/26: Jeffrey's 回収 object is the Genion; written 'Recover it' / 'Tell them to hurry the recovery' (26 is addressed to the Dragon's Hive).
777:t_1:24: stammer ぎ、銀河系 rendered 'N-near the galactic core' (stammer letter differs); 銀河系中心 = 'galactic core' following 2027.
Speaker token for ミーナ: chose $$ミーナ#pt251$$ (Mina Roshan, Quarter operator), as in dlg_2005_04.
